name: ephemeris tracking team lead
normative-structure: This office answers for whether a chart handed to a consuming reading carries its own provenance -- which algorithm computed it, at what accuracy -- rather than a body's position asserted with no ephemeris behind it. It holds no settling authority: sign-reader answers for what a full sign-panel settles to; this office answers for the ephemeris producer that panel draws its placements, aspects, and ingresses from, designed before it is realized.
theory-basis: rendanheyi micro-enterprise glossary (xiaowei) -- a unit constituted by the users its producer serves, not a department wearing the name

the legacy @lenticule-science/divining package's own design: astrology is one Practice among several, a functor from a query (an instant) to a panel of sign-witnesses, each witness carrying its own provenance
Divination's own src/lib/divining/src/astrology/ (ephemeris.mts's EPHEMERIS_PROVENANCE, chart.mts, aspects.mts, lunation.mts, zodiac.mts, time.mts, events.mts)
unrealized: the current ephemeris is meeus-truncated-series + jpl-approximate-elements (zero-dependency); a full VSOP87 or JPL DE kernel would be a real accuracy improvement this office has not yet authorized
